Class TrainingSettings

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.runner.build.training.TrainingSettings
public final class TrainingSettings extends Object
How a training run exercises the application: how the run knows it is ready, what it asks of it, and how it stops it.

A training run launches the application once with java -jar, from the archive the build produced, to learn something from it: the classes it loads at startup, or a JDK cache. It passes the application a free loopback port in portVariable(), waits until it is ready, sends it the workload and stops it; every phase has a timeout, and every process the run started is gone when it ends. The settings describe the application, not the build tool, so both build plugins map theirs onto this one type.

A path is the path of an HTTP request to the application on the loopback interface. It starts with / and may carry a query string.

Settings are made with builder(), and are immutable. Two settings are equal when every setting is.

Compatibility

This type is stable API for all of 1.x. A setting added in a minor release arrives as a new accessor and a new builder setter, whose default keeps the behaviour of the release before; no accessor or setter changes or goes away. A default value changes only in a minor release. Each setting is named like the Gradle property and the Maven parameter that sets it, and every rejection names the setting.

Since:
1.0

    • defaults

      public static TrainingSettings defaults()
      The settings of an application about which nothing is known: a server that reads its port from MICRONAUT_SERVER_PORT, is ready when the port accepts a connection, is sent one GET / and is stopped by destroying its process, with a readiness and a workload timeout of 60 seconds and a stop timeout of 30 seconds. They are the builder's starting values.

      the defaults

    • workloadPaths

      public List<String> workloadPaths()
      The paths to GET in order, each of which must answer 2xx. When this and workloadCommand() are both empty, which is the default, the run sends one GET / and accepts any status below 500.
      Returns:
      the paths, unmodifiable

    • workloadRepeat

      public int workloadRepeat()
      How many times the whole list of workloadPaths() is requested: at least 1, and 1 by default.
      Returns:
      the repeat count

    • workloadCommand

      public List<String> workloadCommand()
      A command and its arguments, run after the paths with "MICRONAUT_RUNNER_TRAINING_URL" set to the application's base URL. It must exit with status 0 within workloadTimeout().
      Returns:
      the command and its arguments, unmodifiable; empty for none, which is the default

    • runToExit

      public boolean runToExit()
      Whether the application ends by itself, as one that is not a server does. There is then no readiness check, no workload and no stop, and the application must exit with status 0 within readinessTimeout(). The default is false.
      Returns:
      whether the application runs to its exit

    • stopPath

      public Optional<String> stopPath()
      The path to POST to stop the application, where an orderly stop needs a request rather than a signal, as on Windows.
      Returns:
      the path, or empty to destroy the process, which is the default
